reports.text:
This week felt mostly in the middle, tipping toward hard. I played every day, and I got 76 right out of 153 cards, so about half. Typed meaning was my comfort zone, 25 of 35, and cloze typed and sentence translation also went fine. Multiple choice was rough at 9 of 27, listen choice only 4 of 12, and cloze choice 0 of 3, which stung.

Words did come back on later days, like пожалуйста, можешь and сказать, which helped. But none repeated within one session, so I never got a second try right away.

What bothers me most is the forgotten words nobody asked about: порядке, день, после, всего, лет, боже, сэр, мистер, жизнь, потом, такой, всех. I saved 53 new words, and these just vanished. Also, 9 spoken answers went unheard and 4 cards didn't match any saved word.

Week 2 felt mixed, mostly medium with a few hard spots. I played all 7 days, and 99 right out of 160 cards is okay. Typed meaning and multiple choice were fine, but read aloud was brutal at 1 of 13, and 13 of my spoken answers were not heard, so I suspect the app's listening is part of it. Typed translation was also tough at 5 of 13.

The same word never repeated within a session, so nothing felt nagging. Some words did return after a gap: можешь after 6 days, делать and сказать after 4. That spacing felt right.

What bothers me is the forgotten words nobody asked: порядке, день, после, всего, лет, боже, сэр, мистер, жизнь, потом, такой, всех. They slipped away and never came back. Also, 6 cards could not be matched to a saved word, which felt odd. I saved 24 new words, but I want the old ones back.
